label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ldapi) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows into filter string via param -> safe (partial replacement) -> filter. Resolved sink value at ctx.search is '(uid=' + user_input_with_partial_escapes + ')' which depends on attacker-controlled input. The replace operations use invalid LDAP escape sequences (\2a instead of proper \ escaping), making the mitigation ineffective against LDAP injection attacks.
